pages.ja:
「む……裏切らないのは当然だが、最後のは頷けない。
どんな酷いコトになってもって、どんな酷いコトだよ？」
pages.en:
“Mm… Of course I won't betray you, but I can't agree to that last part.

“What do you mean, no matter how terrible things become?”

pages.ja:
「そんなの決まってるじゃない。死ぬか、死ぬ一歩手前のコトよ。衛宮くんは元手がないんだから、それぐらいの覚悟は必要でしょ。
それともなに？ 空手でわたしと取り引きしよう、なんて都合のいいコト言うの？」
pages.en:
“Isn't it obvious? Dying—or coming within a hair of it. You have nothing to put up, Emiya, so you'll need at least that much resolve.

“Or what? Did you imagine you could come to the bargaining table empty-handed and still get everything you wanted?”

pages.ja:
「う、ぐ。痛いところをつくな、遠坂」
「当然でしょ。こっちだって遊びじゃないんだから、それぐらいの覚悟を見せてもらわないと割が合わないわ」
「……オッケー、わかった。なんとか善処する」
pages.en:
“Ugh. You know exactly where to strike, Tohsaka.”

“Obviously. This isn't a game for me either. Unless you show me at least that much commitment, it simply isn't worth my while.”

“…Okay, I understand. I'll see what I can do.”
